intro: A soft chiming drifts through the air.$At a weathered roadside shrine, a lone Chimecho floats with its eyes closed — praying.
title: The Praying Chimecho
description: The Chimecho seems to be pleading on behalf of the weak. Your team is not mighty, and it senses that. If you pray alongside it, perhaps something will answer — and lend your Pokémon a fragment of its power.

1.label: Pray Alongside It
1.tooltip:
(+) Choose in turn who receives each aspect:
HP, Atk, Def, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed
(-) Binds you to the Covenant of the Meek
1.prayPrompt: You bow your head beside the Chimecho…$Three presences stir. To whom will you pray?
1.alreadyBlessed: This Pokémon has already been given an aspect.
1.blessingGranted: @s{item_fanfare}{{godName}} answers your prayer!$Its aspects settle over those who stepped forward…
1.covenantWarning: A voice fills your mind:$"I bless the meek, and only the meek."$If a Pokémon evolves, it will outgrow its aspect.$And should a mighty Pokémon join your ranks, my favor will leave you entirely.

2.label: Leave It in Peace
2.selected: You leave the Chimecho to its prayers.$The chiming fades behind you.
